Container.Name: scrob-omnibus
Container.Overview: Self-hosted media tracking for Jellyfin, Plex, and Emby — your private Letterboxd + Trakt. Omnibus image with embedded PostgreSQL (single container). Optional OpenID Connect SSO (Authelia, Authentik, Keycloak, etc.).
Container.Changes: Initial release 2026-06-07: Fix Category tags (MediaApp:Other MediaServer:Other) 2026-10-16: Add optional OIDC/SSO env vars (incl. OIDC_DISCOVERY_URL) and SERVER_URL
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: scrob.app jellyfin plex emby trakt letterboxd media tracker oidc sso authelia authentik keycloak
Container.Description:
Scrob syncs your libraries from Jellyfin, Plex, and Emby, tracks watch history, ratings, and personal lists, and supports webhooks, Radarr/Sonarr requests, and Trakt/Simkl integration.
This template uses the official omnibus image (bellamy/scrob:latest-omnibus) — PostgreSQL runs inside the container; no separate database container is required.
Optional OpenID Connect SSO: set Enable OIDC / SSO and the OIDC variables below (use your reverse-proxy HTTPS URL for Redirect / Discovery). Prefer OIDC Discovery URL for id_token verification. Full guide: https://github.com/ellite/scrob#oidc--single-sign-on
After the container starts, follow the official first-run guide: https://github.com/ellite/scrob#first-setup (create account, TMDB key, connect Jellyfin/Plex/Emby, first sync). Project site: https://scrob.app
HTTPS and PWA install require a reverse proxy (NPM, SWAG, Traefik) in front of port 7330.
Unraid template support: https://forums.unraid.net/topic/199294-support-jorgen-scrob-omnibus/ Scrob application (bugs, features): https://github.com/ellite/scrob/issues

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Scrob web interface

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Scrob application data (settings, uploads)

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Data
Config.Description: Embedded PostgreSQL database (required for omnibus mode)

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Required. JWT signing key. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone (e.g. Australia/Sydney, Europe/Oslo), Use TZ Identifier from: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file ownership. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file ownership. Unraid default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: Enable Registrations
Config.Description: Allow new users to register. Set false after initial setup.

Config.Name: Max Users
Config.Description: Maximum registered users. 0 = unlimited.

Config.Name: Server URL
Config.Description: Public HTTPS URL of this Scrob instance (e.g. https://scrob.example.com). Used for email links and OIDC post-logout defaults when behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Enable OIDC / SSO
Config.Description: Enable OpenID Connect login button. Leave false unless you have an IdP configured.

Config.Name: OIDC Discovery URL
Config.Description: Recommended. IdP OpenID discovery URL — enables id_token verification and stable (issuer, sub) binding. Example: https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration

Config.Name: OIDC Provider Name
Config.Description: Label on the login button (e.g. Authelia, Authentik, Keycloak).

Config.Name: OIDC Client ID
Config.Description: OAuth/OIDC client id registered at your IdP.

Config.Name: OIDC Client Secret
Config.Description: OAuth/OIDC client secret (plaintext). Masked in the UI.

Config.Name: OIDC Auth URL
Config.Description: IdP authorization endpoint. Example: https://auth.example.com/api/oidc/authorization

Config.Name: OIDC Token URL
Config.Description: IdP token endpoint. Example: https://auth.example.com/api/oidc/token

Config.Name: OIDC UserInfo URL
Config.Description: IdP userinfo endpoint. Example: https://auth.example.com/api/oidc/userinfo

Config.Name: OIDC Redirect URL
Config.Description: Must match an IdP redirect URI. Example: https://scrob.example.com/oidc-callback

Config.Name: OIDC Scopes
Config.Description: Space-separated scopes requested from the IdP.

Config.Name: OIDC Auto-create Users
Config.Description: Create a Scrob account on first successful SSO login when no matching user exists.

Config.Name: OIDC Disable Password Login
Config.Description: Hide password login and registration; SSO only. Keep false until SSO is verified.
